notes: Report settings preview uses the corrected compressive strength format (same changes as Labs 2.5.1)
Compressive strength (Load lbs / PSI), cylinders: title now shows both codes — ASTM C39/C39M / AASHTO T 22
Strength rounded to the nearest 10 PSI as ASTM C39 requires (e.g. 4096 → 4100, average 4176 → 4180), on the table and the graph
New optional column: Type of fracture (1–6), required by ASTM C39 — printed only when filled
Age (days) is worked out from the casting and testing dates when the Age box is left empty

Report settings: clicking a test in the left list opens its complete settings page — codes, rate item, used/not used, format, procedure guide, specification limits, report title, subtitle and remarks — with its live report

New: Upload PDF format — reads your PDF, copies the rows and units, corrects spelling and units (e.g. COMPRESIVE → COMPRESSIVE, KN → kN, N/mm2 → MPa), checks the standard, works out formulas, then opens it for editing
Making a new developer key now needs typing NEW KEY, so it cannot happen by mistake
Report settings: test formats listed by the C&W rate schedule (item No., name, rate), with ASTM / AASHTO / BS codes as tags; switch to All A–Z
Search by test name or code (e.g. T 27, C136)
New page: Admin settings → Changes from Claude — this list, and a box to send your next request
Admin settings arranged by category (Access, Laboratories, Data & cloud, System)
Sign-in history, including refused accounts and wrong codes
Activity log; Delete permissions page for all labs
Stays signed in after an automatic update
Report settings: list of all test formats A–Z with search
Google sign-in page comes to the front
Google sign-in for Admin (owner + added Gmail accounts) with Google Authenticator
Fixed sign-in, Google Drive copying and automatic updates on Windows
